requirements.title: COSHAPE COARRAY argument is a valid allocated coarray designator with nonzero corank in the rightmost part-ref
requirements.definition: COARRAY shall be a coarray of any type, shall not be an unallocated allocatable coarray, and if its designator has more than one part-ref the rightmost part-ref shall have nonzero corank.
